releases.title: Major UI Rework, Vehicle Management and Sell

changes.text: Fixed an issue that made some zones inaccessible.
Fixed an issue that made markers invisible in some cases.
Fixed Repair and Fuel actions not updating vehicle data correctly.
Fixed a typo in the jg-textui integration.
Fixed an infinite vehicle model preload.
Fixed incorrect TextUI descriptions for impound and faction impound locations.
Fixed overlapping garage zones and switching between access and parking interactions.
Fixed camera transitions when leaving impounds or withdrawing vehicles.
Fixed withdrawing vehicles from faction impounds.
Optimized DevTools updates. Editing a garage or impound now refreshes only the affected location.
Optimized DevTools camera updates and vehicle lookups.
Optimized vehicle indicator updates to reduce unnecessary NUI messages.
Improved camera framing for taller vehicles.
Added compatibility with Kiminaze's Vehicle Deformation.
Added job grade restrictions for Car Spawner vehicles. You can now set the minimum job grade required for each vehicle.
Added configurable Car Spawner withdrawal limits.
Added Config.ServerLogo for the server logo displayed during transitions.
Added Config.AllowDuplicateVehicleWithdrawal to control whether vehicles with duplicate plates can be withdrawn.
Added different cinematic camera angles when entering garages.
Added background blur to the parking dialog and redesigned interface panels.
Added custom vehicle names that can be edited or removed directly from the vehicle list.
Added consistent vehicle sorting based on category and vehicle name.
Added keyboard navigation and control hints for browsing vehicles, switching categories and confirming actions.
Added confirmation dialogs for vehicle actions and leaving the garage.
Added confirmation when transferring a vehicle to a shared garage.
Added an option to recover impounded vehicles into the currently opened public garage.
Added an option to move personal vehicles from shared garages back into a public garage.
Added an option to withdraw personal vehicles while using shared garages or Car Spawner garages.
Added engine health and fuel indicators to the vehicle preview.
Added electric vehicle detection with a dedicated energy indicator icon.
Added garage notifications with clearer feedback for loading states and vehicle actions.
Added an option to permanently impound a selected vehicle.
Redesigned the garage interface, including navigation, vehicle indicators and action buttons.
Redesigned the vehicle list with category filters, vehicle counters and brand logos.
Redesigned the parking form. Players can now keep a vehicle personal or share it with the garage.
Redesigned the impound form.
Reworked Wall Effect to better adapt to vehicle dimensions, world geometry and uneven terrain.
Reworked garage transition animations and added support for displaying the server logo.
Reworked vehicle transfers with an interactive map and selectable garage locations inspired by the Multicharacter Spawn Selector.
Added the Sell feature, which allows players to sell vehicles to other players directly through the garage.

releases.title: Faction Impounds, Boat & Aircraft Support - Hotfix #1

changes.text: Added compatibility to impound npc vehicles.
Optimized thread for drawing markers.
Fixed issue with accessing vehicle from the other player while player source is selecting it.
Fixed issue with the car spawner feature not being able to park vehicles.

Created Faction Impound logic that allows impounded vehicles by /impound command to be accessible only through Faction Impound until vehicle is not released to the player or timer ends. It's useful to for example search the vehicle after impounding it.
Created new types of the garages such as boats and planes.
Created new category for creator to create new garage types.
Created impound logic for new garage types.
Created command handler and introduced /dvdb command.
Created built-in basic help notification.
Created /restore_impound command that's needed to store vehicle again in Faction Impound after withdrawing it.
Applied saving of the state in dev tools. Now no data will be lost when changing route.
Applied ZSX_IsInFactionImpound statebag to determine whether player is inside Faction Impound or not.
Applied garage notifications that determines action fallback.
Applied different logic for blips to predefine what blip purpose is, for example boat garage is called Garage - Boat (changeable via config).
Applied logic for entity types. Now you need to use shared/config_vehicles.lua Config.Vehicles table so resource can determine what entity type you're using.
Applied new view for garage types in DevTools.
Added Config.Blips.factionImpounds data for Faction Impounds blip.
Added translations for faction_impound prefix.
Changed logic for handling DevTools > Vehicles view. Right now you got access to manually select which garage vehicle should be transfered to, owner list to easily manipulate the data and more.
Changed logic of server sided callback to return more data with error handles.
Changed design of the list component. Vehicle data now will match overall design even better.
Fixed issue with vehicle removal when spawning new entity.
Fixed issue with displayStatus not being properly recognized.
Fixed issue with data traffic in DevTools component.
Fixed issue with navbar vehicle data props not being encoded before the update.
Added compatibility to impound npc vehicles.
Added compatibility to impound npc vehicles.
Applied prevention so players can no longer spam park key.
Fixed issue with the naming in creator that prevented people from using 0 number.
Fixed issue with x-fuel compatibility.
Fixed issue with camera rotation while on bike.
Fixed issue with DevTools vehicles list being not scrollable.
Fixed issue with Config.GatherVehiclesListOnExecute variable while database queue system was set to active.
Fixed issue with the table layout on gathering player citizen id for QBCore/QBOX users.
